== Summary ==
Jerry Cook III of Manhattan, Kansas is Star Trek CCG champion from Bajor. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
